```python
from maxpylang.objects import counter, ezdac_tilde, metro, noise_tilde, teeth_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
hiss = patch.place(noise_tilde)[0]
comb = patch.place(teeth_tilde(20, 1, 2, 0.3, 0.3, 0.9))[0]   # max ms, feedforward ms, feedback ms, gain, ff, feedback
clock = patch.place(metro(500, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(2, 10))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.03")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (hiss.outs[0], comb.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], comb.ins[2]),       # feedback delay, in ms
    (comb.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("teeth_tilde")
```

### `rampsmooth~` (`rampsmooth_tilde`)

Smooth an incoming signal

**Glide between notes.** counter steps through 220, 330, 440 and 550 Hz, and sig~ turns each into a signal that jumps. rampsmooth~ 4410 4410 spreads every jump over 4410 samples (0.1 s at 44.1 kHz), so cycle~ slides.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, rampsmooth_tilde, sig_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(400, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(2, 5))[0]
hz = patch.place("* 110")[0]                       # 220, 330, 440, 550
jump = patch.place(sig_tilde(220))[0]
glide = patch.place(rampsmooth_tilde(4410, 4410))[0]   # ramp up, ramp down, in samples
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(0))[0]               # 0: the frequency comes from the signal
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], jump.ins[0]),
    (jump.outs[0], glide.ins[0]),
    (glide.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("rampsmooth_tilde")
```

### `deltaclip~` (`deltaclip_tilde`)

Limit changes in signal amplitude

**Soften a square wave.** deltaclip~ -0.02 0.02 lets a signal move at most 0.02 per sample, so rect~'s instant jumps from -1 to 1 become 100-sample slopes and the square sounds rounder.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import deltaclip_tilde, ezdac_tilde, rect_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
square = patch.place(rect_tilde(110))[0]
slew = patch.place(deltaclip_tilde(-0.02, 0.02))[0]   # fastest fall, fastest rise, per sample
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (square.outs[0], slew.ins[0]),
    (slew.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("deltaclip_tilde")
```

## Envelopes

Change a value smoothly over time: fades, swells, notes.

### `line~` (`line_tilde`)

Linear signal ramp generator

**A plucked note.** line~ ramps a signal to a target over a time. The list "1 10 0 400" is two segments: up to 1 in 10 ms, then down to 0 over 400 ms; multiplying by it shapes each note.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(600, active=1))[0]
shape = patch.place("message 1 10 0 400")[0]   # pairs: target, time in ms
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(440))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]              # times the envelope (silent until it rises)
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], shape.ins[0]),
    (shape.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),         # the envelope sets the volume
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("pluck")
```

### `curve~` (`curve_tilde`)

Exponential ramp generator

**A curved fade.** curve~ is line~ with a bend: each segment is three numbers, target, time and curve. A curve of 0.8 makes the 800 ms fade drop fast, then linger.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import curve_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, tri_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(1000, active=1))[0]
shape = patch.place("message 1 5 0 0 800 0.8")[0]   # triples: target, time ms, curve
env = patch.place(curve_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(tri_tilde(330))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]              # times the envelope (silent until it rises)
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], shape.ins[0]),
    (shape.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("curve")
```

### `adsr~` (`adsr_tilde`)

ADSR envelope generator

**Attack, decay, sustain, release.** adsr~ makes a classic note envelope. A number above 0 starts the note at that level; 0 releases it. counter alternates 1 and 0, so the note holds for 600 ms, then fades.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import adsr_tilde, counter, ezdac_tilde, metro, saw_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(600, active=1))[0]
gate = patch.place(counter(0, 1))[0]               # 0, 1, 0, 1, ...
env = patch.place(adsr_tilde(10, 150, 0.5, 300))[0]  # attack, decay ms, sustain level, release ms
osc = patch.place(saw_tilde(110))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]              # times the envelope (silent until it rises)
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], gate.ins[0]),
    (gate.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("adsr")
```

### `trapezoid~` (`trapezoid_tilde`)

Trapezoidal wavetable

**Repeating swells.** trapezoid~ 0.05 0.5 reshapes phasor~'s 0..1 ramp: up to 1 by phase 0.05, held until 0.5, then down to 0 at the end. Used as volume, each third of a second starts fast and fades.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, phasor_tilde, trapezoid_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
ramp = patch.place(phasor_tilde(3))[0]                 # 0..1, three times a second
shape = patch.place(trapezoid_tilde(0.05, 0.5))[0]     # phases where it reaches 1 and leaves it
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(523))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]                          # times the shape
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (ramp.outs[0], shape.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (shape.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("trapezoid_tilde")
```

## Delay

Echoes and time-shifted copies of a signal.

### `delay~` (`delay_tilde`)

Delay a signal

**An echo, in samples.** delay~ delays a signal by a number of samples. Its first argument (required) is the most it can hold: 44100 samples, one second. Here each pluck repeats 11025 samples (a quarter second) later.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, delay_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(1000, active=1))[0]
shape = patch.place("message 1 5 0 150")[0]
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(660))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]              # times the envelope (silent until it rises)
echo = patch.place(delay_tilde(44100, 11025))[0]   # max samples, delay samples
mix = patch.place("+~")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], shape.ins[0]),
    (shape.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], mix.ins[0]),         # the dry pluck
    (amp.outs[0], echo.ins[0]),
    (echo.outs[0], mix.ins[1]),        # plus its echo
    (mix.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("echo")
```

### `tapin~` (`tapin_tilde`)

Input to a delay line

**Echoes that fade: tapin~ and tapout~.** tapin~ records into a delay line and tapout~ reads it back 300 ms later. Feeding half the echo back in makes it repeat, quieter each time.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro, tapin_tilde, tapout_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(2000, active=1))[0]
shape = patch.place("message 1 5 0 120")[0]
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(523))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]              # times the envelope (silent until it rises)
mix = patch.place("+~")[0]
rec = patch.place(tapin_tilde(1000))[0]      # holds up to 1000 ms
tap = patch.place(tapout_tilde(300))[0]      # reads 300 ms back
fade = patch.place("*~ 0.5")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], shape.ins[0]),
    (shape.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], mix.ins[0]),
    (mix.outs[0], rec.ins[0]),
    (rec.outs[0], tap.ins[0]),         # tapin~ always connects to tapout~
    (tap.outs[0], fade.ins[0]),
    (fade.outs[0], mix.ins[1]),        # feedback: the echo goes round again
    (mix.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("taps")
```

### `tapout~` (`tapout_tilde`)

Output from a delay line

**An echo on the right.** tapin~ keeps the last second of the notes and tapout~ reads it 375 ms later: you hear each note on the left, then its echo on the right. Press ▶, then drag the dial to set the echo from 0 to 1000 ms.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, dial, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro, scale, tapin_tilde, tapout_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(750, active=1))[0]
shape = patch.place("message 1 5 0 150")[0]
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(660))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]                  # times the envelope
rec = patch.place(tapin_tilde(1000))[0]        # holds up to 1000 ms
knob = patch.place(dial)[0]
ms = patch.place(scale(0, 127, 0, 1000))[0]
tap = patch.place(tapout_tilde(375))[0]        # 375 ms back until you move the dial
quiet_l = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
quiet_r = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], shape.ins[0]), (shape.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]), (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], rec.ins[0]),
    (rec.outs[0], tap.ins[0]),                 # tapin~ always connects to tapout~
    (knob.outs[0], ms.ins[0]), (ms.outs[0], tap.ins[0]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet_l.ins[0]), (tap.outs[0], quiet_r.ins[0]),
    (quiet_l.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet_r.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("tapout_tilde")
```

## Dynamics

Loudness, saturation and distortion.

### `limi~` (`limi_tilde`)

Lookahead peak-limiter

**A swell held under the ceiling.** The tone swells to three times full scale, far past the 1 where a speaker would clip. limi~ looks ahead and turns the peaks down, so the swell flattens out at the top instead of distorting.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, limi_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(0.5))[0]    # once every 2 seconds
span = patch.place("*~ 1.5")[0]
level = patch.place("+~ 1.5")[0]          # 0..3
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(220))[0]
loud = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]            # peaks up to 3
limit = patch.place(limi_tilde)[0]        # back under 1
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], span.ins[0]),
    (span.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], loud.ins[0]),
    (level.outs[0], loud.ins[1]),
    (loud.outs[0], limit.ins[0]),
    (limit.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("limi_tilde")
```

### `degrade~` (`degrade_tilde`)

Signal quality reducer

**Lo-fi: fewer bits.** degrade~ lowers the sample rate and bit depth. 0.2 of the rate and 4 bits turn a sine into a crunchy video-game tone.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, degrade_tilde, ezdac_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(330))[0]
crunch = patch.place(degrade_tilde(0.2, 4))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]        # turn it down
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]       # to both speakers

patch.connect(
    (osc.outs[0], crunch.ins[0]),
    (crunch.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("degrade_tilde")
```

### `gate~` (`gate_tilde`)

Route a signal to one of several outlets

**Chop a drone.** gate~ 1 1 passes the signal in its right inlet while its left inlet is 1 and outputs silence at 0. metro and counter alternate 1 and 0 every 250 ms, chopping a filtered sawtooth into pulses.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, ezdac_tilde, gate_tilde, lores_tilde, metro, saw_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
onoff = patch.place(counter(0, 1))[0]      # 0, 1, 0, 1 ...
saw = patch.place(saw_tilde(110))[0]
soft = patch.place(lores_tilde(800, 0.3))[0]
gate = patch.place(gate_tilde(1, 1))[0]     # 1 outlet, open to start
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], onoff.ins[0]),
    (onoff.outs[0], gate.ins[0]),
    (saw.outs[0], soft.ins[0]),
    (soft.outs[0], gate.ins[1]),
    (gate.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("gate_tilde")
```

### `overdrive~` (`overdrive_tilde`)

Soft-clipping signal distortion

**Warm distortion.** overdrive~ bends a signal's waveform the way an overdriven amplifier does; its argument is the drive (1 is clean). A 110 Hz sine driven to 6 sounds buzzy and full. Press ▶, then drag the number box to change the drive.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, number, overdrive_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(110))[0]
amount = patch.place(number)[0]
fuzz = patch.place(overdrive_tilde(6))[0]     # drive 6 until you change the number
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (osc.outs[0], fuzz.ins[0]),
    (amount.outs[0], fuzz.ins[1]),
    (fuzz.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("overdrive")
```

### `tanh~` (`tanh_tilde`)

Signal hyperbolic tangent function

**Soft saturation.** tanh~ squeezes a signal smoothly into -1..1: quiet parts pass almost unchanged, loud parts round off, like tape or a tube. A sine boosted 4 times comes out warm and slightly square. Press ▶, then drag the number box to change the boost.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, number, tanh_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(147))[0]
boost = patch.place("*~ 4")[0]              # 4 times louder, until you change the number
amount = patch.place(number)[0]
soft = patch.place(tanh_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (osc.outs[0], boost.ins[0]),
    (amount.outs[0], boost.ins[1]),
    (boost.outs[0], soft.ins[0]),
    (soft.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("tanh")
```

### `pong~` (`pong_tilde`)

Variable range signal folding

**A wavefolder.** pong~ folds a signal back whenever it goes past its limits (mode 0, between -1 and 1), so a loud sine turns into a bright, buzzing wave. A slow LFO changes how loud it goes in, so the tone opens and closes.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, pong_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(110))[0]
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(0.3))[0]       # once every 3 seconds
depth = patch.place("*~ 2")[0]
level = patch.place("+~ 3")[0]               # a gain swinging 1..5
loud = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]               # times that gain (0. so the signal sets it)
fold = patch.place(pong_tilde(0, -1, 1))[0]  # mode 0 = fold, low -1, high 1
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], depth.ins[0]), (depth.outs[0], level.ins[0]), (level.outs[0], loud.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], loud.ins[0]), (loud.outs[0], fold.ins[0]),
    (fold.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("pong")
```

## Samples

Recorded sound. buffer~ does not load files in this browser, so these play silence here unless the example records into it.

### `playlist~` (`playlist_tilde`)

Play sound files

**A two-sound drum loop.** loadbang appends two sound files to playlist~, and a number plays that clip: counter alternates 1 and 2 every 250 ms, so the kick-and-hat and the snare take turns.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, ezdac_tilde, loadbang, metro, playlist_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadbang)[0]
files = patch.place("message append bd+hh.aiff, append snare.aiff")[0]   # files that come with Max
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
clip = patch.place(counter(1, 2))[0]        # clips count from 1
player = patch.place(playlist_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], files.ins[0]),
    (files.outs[0], player.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], clip.ins[0]),
    (clip.outs[0], player.ins[0]),
    (player.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),         # left channel
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("playlist_tilde")
```

### `buffer~` (`buffer_tilde`)

Store audio samples

**Loading a sound file.** buffer~ loads a sound file into memory under a name, here drums; any object that names drums can play it. groove~ loops it at normal speed: a signal of 1 into its left inlet. drumLoop.aif comes with Max; on this page a CC0 drum loop stands in for it.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import buffer_tilde, ezdac_tilde, groove_tilde, sig_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
drums = patch.place(buffer_tilde("drums", "drumLoop.aif"))[0]
speed = patch.place(sig_tilde(1))[0]                  # 1 = normal speed
player = patch.place(groove_tilde("drums", loop=1))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.3")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (speed.outs[0], player.ins[0]),
    (player.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("drum_loop")
```

### `play~` (`play_tilde`)

Position-based sample playback

**Playing part of a file with line~.** play~ outputs the sample at the position its input signal gives, in milliseconds. Every 1.6 seconds the message sends line~ back to 0 and then on to 1500 over 1500 ms, so play~ plays the first 1.5 seconds of the loop, again and again. drumLoop.aif comes with Max; on this page a CC0 drum loop stands in for it.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import buffer_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro, play_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
drums = patch.place(buffer_tilde("drums", "drumLoop.aif"))[0]
clock = patch.place(metro(1600, active=1))[0]
sweep = patch.place("message 0 0 1500 1500")[0]      # to 0 in 0 ms, then to 1500 in 1500 ms
position = patch.place(line_tilde(0))[0]
player = patch.place(play_tilde("drums"))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.3")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], sweep.ins[0]),
    (sweep.outs[0], position.ins[0]),
    (position.outs[0], player.ins[0]),
    (player.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("play_part")
```

### `groove~` (`groove_tilde`)

Variable-rate looping sample playback

**Speeding a loop up and down.** groove~ plays a buffer~ at the speed of the signal in its left inlet: 1 is normal, 2 is twice as fast and an octave up. A slow sine swings the speed between 0.5 and 1.5 every four seconds, so the loop drags and rushes. drumLoop.aif comes with Max; on this page a CC0 drum loop stands in for it.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import buffer_tilde, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, groove_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
drums = patch.place(buffer_tilde("drums", "drumLoop.aif"))[0]
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(0.25))[0]
depth = patch.place("*~ 0.5")[0]
centre = patch.place("+~ 1")[0]                       # speed 0.5 to 1.5
player = patch.place(groove_tilde("drums", loop=1))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.3")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], depth.ins[0]),
    (depth.outs[0], centre.ins[0]),
    (centre.outs[0], player.ins[0]),
    (player.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("groove_speed")
```

### `record~` (`record_tilde`)

Record sound into a buffer

**Grabbing a stutter from a loop.** record~ records a signal into a buffer~: 1 starts it, and it stops by itself when the buffer~ is full. Here the drum loop plays (silently) into record~, and every 2.4 seconds metro starts a new take, so the 400 ms buffer~ "snip" fills with whatever the drums are playing. groove~ loops snip, and you hear one beat of the loop stuttering, a new one with each take. drumLoop.aif comes with Max; on this page a CC0 drum loop stands in for it.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import buffer_tilde, ezdac_tilde, groove_tilde, metro, record_tilde, sig_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
drums = patch.place(buffer_tilde("drums", "drumLoop.aif"))[0]
snip = patch.place(buffer_tilde("snip", 400))[0]          # 400 ms of memory to record into
speed = patch.place(sig_tilde(1))[0]
source = patch.place(groove_tilde("drums", loop=1))[0]     # the drum loop, not sent to the speakers
clock = patch.place(metro(2400, active=1))[0]
start = patch.place("message 1")[0]                        # 1 starts recording
rec = patch.place(record_tilde("snip"))[0]
player = patch.place(groove_tilde("snip", loop=1))[0]      # loops the 400 ms take
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.3")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (speed.outs[0], source.ins[0]),
    (source.outs[0], rec.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], start.ins[0]),
    (start.outs[0], rec.ins[0]),
    (speed.outs[0], player.ins[0]),
    (player.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("record_stutter")
```

## Routing

Send signals and messages between parts of a patch.

### `send~` (`send_tilde`)

Send signals without patch cords

**Audio without a cord.** send~ and receive~ with the same name ("tone") connect without a patch cord: useful in a large patch, or between subpatches.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, receive_tilde, send_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(294))[0]
tx = patch.place(send_tilde("tone"))[0]
rx = patch.place(receive_tilde("tone"))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (osc.outs[0], tx.ins[0]),
    (rx.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("send")
```

### `receive~` (`receive_tilde`)

Signals can be received from any loaded patcher, without patch cords

**Switch which sender you hear.** Two send~ objects broadcast a sine under the name low and a sawtooth under high. receive~ plays one of them, and the message set high (or set low) re-points it; metro switches every half second.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, receive_tilde, saw_tilde, select, send_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
sine = patch.place(cycle_tilde(220))[0]
to_low = patch.place(send_tilde("low"))[0]
saw = patch.place(saw_tilde(330))[0]
to_high = patch.place(send_tilde("high"))[0]
clock = patch.place(metro(500, active=1))[0]
which = patch.place(counter(0, 1))[0]
pick = patch.place(select(0, 1))[0]
low = patch.place("message set low")[0]
high = patch.place("message set high")[0]
listen = patch.place(receive_tilde("low"))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (sine.outs[0], to_low.ins[0]), (saw.outs[0], to_high.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], which.ins[0]), (which.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], low.ins[0]), (pick.outs[1], high.ins[0]),
    (low.outs[0], listen.ins[0]), (high.outs[0], listen.ins[0]),
    (listen.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("receive_tilde")
```

### `selector~` (`selector_tilde`)

Assign one of several inputs to an outlet

**Let a signal through, or not.** selector~ 1 1 has one signal input, open to start; its left inlet picks which input to pass, and 0 picks none. Press ▶, then click the toggle on and off: off sends 0 and the tone stops, on sends 1 and it returns.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, selector_tilde, toggle

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
switch = patch.place(toggle)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(294))[0]
choose = patch.place(selector_tilde(1, 1))[0]   # 1 input, input 1 open
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (switch.outs[0], choose.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], choose.ins[1]),
    (choose.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("selector_tilde")
```

### `matrix~` (`matrix_tilde`)

Signal routing and mixing matrix

**Crossfade two tones.** matrix~ 2 1 mixes two inputs into one output. A list "inlet outlet gain ramp-ms" sets one connection, so each message fades one tone in and the other out over 300 ms, every second.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, matrix_tilde, metro, select

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(1000, active=1))[0]
which = patch.place(counter(0, 1))[0]
pick = patch.place(select(0, 1))[0]
to_a = patch.place("message 0 0 1. 300, 1 0 0. 300")[0]   # in 0 up, in 1 down
to_b = patch.place("message 0 0 0. 300, 1 0 1. 300")[0]   # in 0 down, in 1 up
low = patch.place(cycle_tilde(220))[0]
high = patch.place(cycle_tilde(330))[0]
mix = patch.place(matrix_tilde(2, 1))[0]   # 2 inlets, 1 outlet; every gain starts at 0
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], which.ins[0]), (which.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], to_a.ins[0]), (pick.outs[1], to_b.ins[0]),
    (to_a.outs[0], mix.ins[0]), (to_b.outs[0], mix.ins[0]),
    (low.outs[0], mix.ins[0]),
    (high.outs[0], mix.ins[1]),
    (mix.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("matrix_tilde")
```

### `send` (`send`)

Send messages without patch cords

**Messages without a cord.** send passes messages to every receive with the same name ("notes"), anywhere in the patch, with no cord between them. Here a metro and counter play a melody into send, and a receive on the far side plays it.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, receive, send

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
up = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
tx = patch.place(send("notes"))[0]
rx = patch.place(receive("notes"))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], tx.ins[0]),
    (rx.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("send")
```

### `receive` (`receive`)

Receive messages without patch cords

**Messages without a cord.** receive outputs whatever is sent to its name from anywhere in the patch, with no cord. Here forward sends each note to "note", and two receives turn it into a root and a fifth on two oscillators.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, forward, metro, mtof, receive

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(48, 55))[0]
tx = patch.place(forward("note"))[0]
root = patch.place(receive("note"))[0]
other = patch.place(receive("note"))[0]
fifth = patch.place("+ 7")[0]
hz_a = patch.place(mtof)[0]
hz_b = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc_a = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
osc_b = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
mix = patch.place("+~")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.15")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect((clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]), (step.outs[0], tx.ins[0]))
patch.connect((root.outs[0], hz_a.ins[0]), (hz_a.outs[0], osc_a.ins[0]),
              (other.outs[0], fifth.ins[0]), (fifth.outs[0], hz_b.ins[0]), (hz_b.outs[0], osc_b.ins[0]),
              (osc_a.outs[0], mix.ins[0]), (osc_b.outs[0], mix.ins[1]), (mix.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
              (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]))
patch.save("receive")
```

### `forward` (`forward`)

Send messages to specified receive objects

**Send to a name you can change.** forward sends what it gets to every receive with its name, with no cord, and "send <name>" changes the name. Notes go to "low" (two octaves down) until you click the toggle, which forwards them to "high". Press ▶, then click the toggle.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, forward, metro, mtof, random, receive, select, toggle

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
flip = patch.place(toggle)[0]
which = patch.place(select(0, 1))[0]
to_low = patch.place("message send low")[0]
to_high = patch.place("message send high")[0]
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(12))[0]
fwd = patch.place(forward("low"))[0]
low = patch.place(receive("low"))[0]
high = patch.place(receive("high"))[0]
down = patch.place("+ 48")[0]
up = patch.place("+ 72")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect((flip.outs[0], which.ins[0]), (which.outs[0], to_low.ins[0]), (which.outs[1], to_high.ins[0]),
              (to_low.outs[0], fwd.ins[0]), (to_high.outs[0], fwd.ins[0]),
              (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]), (pick.outs[0], fwd.ins[0]))
patch.connect((low.outs[0], down.ins[0]), (high.outs[0], up.ins[0]),   # no cord from fwd
              (down.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
              (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]))
patch.save("forward")
```

### `value` (`value`)

Share data between other value objects

**One number, shared by name.** Every value with the same name ("root") shares one stored number. One value is set once at start-up; another, elsewhere, is read by each beat, so the melody is built on that root. Press ▶, then drag the number box to change the root note.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, loadbang, metro, mtof, number, trigger, value

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadbang)[0]
first = patch.place("message 57")[0]
root = patch.place(number)[0]
store = patch.place(value("root"))[0]          # sets the shared number
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 4))[0]
order = patch.place(trigger("i", "b"))[0]      # right first: read the root, then add the step
read = patch.place(value("root"))[0]           # the same number, read here
add = patch.place("+ 0")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], first.ins[0]), (first.outs[0], store.ins[0]), (root.outs[0], store.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]), (step.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], read.ins[0]), (read.outs[0], add.ins[1]),
    (order.outs[0], add.ins[0]), (add.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("value")
```

### `pv` (`pv`)

Share data within a patch hierarchy

**A value private to this patch.** pv works like value, but its name ("step") is shared only inside this patch and its subpatches, so two copies of a patch don't interfere. One pv counts; another, elsewhere, is read on each beat to choose the note.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, pv, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 6))[0]
order = patch.place(trigger("b", "i"))[0]      # right first: store the step, then read it
keep = patch.place(pv("step"))[0]
read = patch.place(pv("step"))[0]
fifths = patch.place("* 7")[0]
fold = patch.place("% 12")[0]                  # fold into one octave
up = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]), (step.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], keep.ins[0]), (order.outs[0], read.ins[0]),
    (read.outs[0], fifths.ins[0]), (fifths.outs[0], fold.ins[0]),
    (fold.outs[0], up.ins[0]), (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("pv")
```

## Analysis

Turn audio into numbers you can see or use.

### `snapshot~` (`snapshot_tilde`)

Convert signal values to numbers

**Audio to numbers.** snapshot~ samples a signal as a number, here every 125 ms. A slow sine becomes a stepping melody: scale maps -1..1 to MIDI notes 60..72.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, mtof, scale, snapshot_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(0.2))[0]
grab = patch.place(snapshot_tilde(125))[0]   # report every 125 ms
note = patch.place(scale(-1, 1, 60, 72))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], grab.ins[0]),
    (grab.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("snapshot")
```

### `meter~` (`meter_tilde`)

Visual peak level indicator

**Watch a level move.** meter~ reports the peak of the signal coming in, a few times a second. Here a tone swells and fades every two seconds, and * 127 turns the 0..1 peak into a position for the slider, which rises and falls with it.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, meter_tilde, slider

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(0.5))[0]
span = patch.place("*~ 0.5")[0]
level = patch.place("+~ 0.5")[0]          # 0..1
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(440))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]             # times the level
watch = patch.place(meter_tilde)[0]
pos = patch.place("* 127.")[0]
show = patch.place(slider)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], span.ins[0]), (span.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]), (level.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], watch.ins[0]),
    (watch.outs[0], pos.ins[0]), (pos.outs[0], show.ins[0]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("meter_tilde")
```

### `number~` (`number_tilde`)

Signal monitor and constant generator

**A ramp read out as notes.** number~ shows a signal's value and sends it out its right outlet as a number, ten times a second. Reading phasor~'s slow 0..1 ramp, those numbers become a pitch that climbs in steps from 200 to 600 Hz every two seconds.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, number_tilde, phasor_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
ramp = patch.place(phasor_tilde(0.5))[0]   # 0..1 every 2 seconds
show = patch.place(number_tilde)[0]
span = patch.place("* 400.")[0]
hz = patch.place("+ 200.")[0]              # 200..600 Hz
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(200))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (ramp.outs[0], show.ins[0]),
    (show.outs[1], span.ins[0]),           # right outlet: the value as a number
    (span.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("number_tilde")
```

### `peakamp~` (`peakamp_tilde`)

Report the maximum amplitude of a signal

**Louder is brighter.** peakamp~ 50 reports the loudest sample it heard every 50 ms. A sawtooth swells and fades, and its peak, times 3000, sets lores~'s cutoff: the filter opens as the sound gets louder.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, lores_tilde, peakamp_tilde, saw_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(0.5))[0]
span = patch.place("*~ 0.5")[0]
level = patch.place("+~ 0.5")[0]           # 0..1
saw = patch.place(saw_tilde(110))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]              # times the level
peak = patch.place(peakamp_tilde(50))[0]   # report every 50 ms
hz = patch.place("* 3000.")[0]
cutoff = patch.place("+ 200.")[0]          # 200..3200 Hz
filt = patch.place(lores_tilde(500, 0.6))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], span.ins[0]), (span.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (saw.outs[0], amp.ins[0]), (level.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], peak.ins[0]), (peak.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], cutoff.ins[0]), (cutoff.outs[0], filt.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], filt.ins[0]),
    (filt.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("peakamp_tilde")
```

### `avg~` (`avg_tilde`)

Signal average

**A second voice that follows the level.** On each bang avg~ reports the average size of the signal since the last bang. metro asks ten times a second while a tone pulses, and the answer sets a second tone's pitch: it slides up as the first gets louder.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import avg_tilde, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, scale

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(0.5))[0]
span = patch.place("*~ 0.5")[0]
level = patch.place("+~ 0.5")[0]          # 0..1
voice = patch.place(cycle_tilde(220))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]             # times the level
clock = patch.place(metro(100, active=1))[0]
measure = patch.place(avg_tilde)[0]
hz = patch.place(scale(0., 1., 330., 1130.))[0]   # level 0..1 to 330..1130 Hz
follow = patch.place(cycle_tilde(330))[0]
mix = patch.place("+~")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], span.ins[0]), (span.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (voice.outs[0], amp.ins[0]), (level.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], measure.ins[0]), (clock.outs[0], measure.ins[0]),
    (measure.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], follow.ins[0]),
    (amp.outs[0], mix.ins[0]), (follow.outs[0], mix.ins[1]),
    (mix.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("avg_tilde")
```

### `thresh~` (`thresh_tilde`)

Detect signal above a set level

**Turn a slow wave into on and off.** thresh~ 0 0.5 outputs 1 once its input rises past 0.5 and 0 once it falls below 0. Fed a 1 Hz sine, it switches a tone on and off; rampsmooth~ rounds each switch over 10 ms so it doesn't click.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, rampsmooth_tilde, thresh_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(1))[0]
switch = patch.place(thresh_tilde(0, 0.5))[0]       # reset below 0, set above 0.5
soft = patch.place(rampsmooth_tilde(441, 441))[0]   # 441 samples = 10 ms
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(523))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]                       # times the 0/1 switch
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], switch.ins[0]),
    (switch.outs[0], soft.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (soft.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("thresh_tilde")
```

### `edge~` (`edge_tilde`)

Detect logical signal transitions

**Two notes from one switch.** edge~ bangs its left outlet when a signal turns non-zero and its right outlet when it returns to zero. thresh~ makes a 1 Hz on/off signal, and the two bangs alternate the tone between 660 and 440 Hz.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, edge_tilde, ezdac_tilde, thresh_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
lfo = patch.place(cycle_tilde(1))[0]
switch = patch.place(thresh_tilde(0, 0.5))[0]   # 1 above 0.5, back to 0 below 0
edges = patch.place(edge_tilde)[0]
up = patch.place("message 660")[0]
down = patch.place("message 440")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(440))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (lfo.outs[0], switch.ins[0]),
    (switch.outs[0], edges.ins[0]),
    (edges.outs[0], up.ins[0]),       # 0 -> non-zero
    (edges.outs[1], down.ins[0]),     # non-zero -> 0
    (up.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (down.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("edge_tilde")
```

## Math

Arithmetic and conversions on numbers.

### `expr` (`expr`)

Evaluate a mathematical expression

**Math written as a formula.** expr evaluates a C-like formula; $i1 is the integer arriving in its left inlet. Here "$i1 * 7 % 12 + 60" turns a count into notes a fifth apart, folded into one octave: a whole melody from one box.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(220, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 11))[0]
notes = patch.place("expr $i1 * 7 % 12 + 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], notes.ins[0]),
    (notes.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("expr")
```

### `+` (`plus`)

**Adding to a number.** + adds its argument to every number it gets. counter makes 0..7; + 60 moves that up to the notes from middle C.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
up = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("plus")
```

### `*` (`times`)

**Multiplying a number.** * multiplies: 0, 1, 2, 3 times 7 gives 0, 7, 14, 21, a chain of fifths above note 48.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 3))[0]
fifths = patch.place("* 7")[0]
up = patch.place("+ 48")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], fifths.ins[0]),
    (fifths.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("times")
```

### `rdiv` (`rdiv`)

Divide input from a number

**The undertone series.** !/ divides its argument BY its input: 1760 / 1, 1760 / 2, 1760 / 3 ... The pitch falls in ever smaller steps, from 1760 Hz down to 220 Hz.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(1, 8))[0]
under = patch.place("!/ 1760.")[0]   # the . makes it divide as floats
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], under.ins[0]),
    (under.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("rdiv")
```

**From period to frequency.** rdiv is the long name of !/. A wave that repeats every 2, 3 ... 9 ms has a frequency of 1000 divided by that, so rdiv 1000. turns the periods into 500 Hz down to 111 Hz.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
period = patch.place(counter(2, 9))[0]
hz = patch.place("rdiv 1000.")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], period.ins[0]),
    (period.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("rdiv")
```

### `rminus` (`rminus`)

Subtraction object (inlets reversed)

**Subtracting from a number.** !- subtracts its input FROM the argument: 72 - 0, 72 - 1, ... 72 - 12. A rising counter becomes a falling chromatic scale.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(160, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 12))[0]
down = patch.place("!- 72")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], down.ins[0]),
    (down.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("rminus")
```

**Turning an arpeggio upside down.** rminus is the long name of !-. 0, 3, 6 ... 21 counted up in minor thirds; rminus 84 gives 84 minus each, so the same arpeggio falls from note 84.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(220, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
thirds = patch.place("* 3")[0]
flip = patch.place("rminus 84")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], thirds.ins[0]),
    (thirds.outs[0], flip.ins[0]),
    (flip.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("rminus")
```

### `div` (`div`)

Divide two numbers

**Dividing a number.** / divides by its argument. counter's 0..15 divided by 15. gives 0 to 1 in sixteen steps, used as the volume of a 220 Hz tone: it swells, then starts again. The . in 15. makes the division float; / 15 would give only 0 or 1.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
share = patch.place("/ 15.")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(220))[0]
level = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]      # the right inlet sets the volume
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], share.ins[0]),
    (share.outs[0], level.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (level.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("div")
```

**Dividing a harmonic series.** div is the long name of /. Multiples of 330 Hz divided by 4. play the harmonics of 82.5 Hz, climbing from low to high. Press ▶, then drag the number box to change the divisor: a bigger number moves the whole series lower.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(1, 16))[0]
hz = patch.place("* 330")[0]
divisor = patch.place(number)[0]
lower = patch.place("div 4.")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], lower.ins[0]),
    (divisor.outs[0], lower.ins[1]),   # cold inlet: used from the next note
    (lower.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("div")
```

### `minus` (`minus`)

Subtract two numbers, output the result

**Transposing down.** minus is the long name of -: it subtracts its argument. The counter plays notes 72..79, and minus 12 moves them an octave down. Press ▶, then drag the number box to transpose by a different interval.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(72, 79))[0]
interval = patch.place(number)[0]
down = patch.place("minus 12")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], down.ins[0]),
    (interval.outs[0], down.ins[1]),
    (down.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("minus")
```

### `modulo` (`modulo`)

Divide two numbers, output the remainder

**Wrapping a count into a loop.** % gives the remainder after dividing. A counter climbing 0..59, % 5 becomes 0 1 2 3 4 0 1 2 ..., a five-note whole-tone loop. Press ▶, then drag the number box to change the loop length.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 59))[0]
length = patch.place(number)[0]
wrap = patch.place("% 5")[0]
tone = patch.place("* 2")[0]
up = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], wrap.ins[0]),
    (length.outs[0], wrap.ins[1]),
    (wrap.outs[0], tone.ins[0]),
    (tone.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("modulo")
```

**Folding notes into one octave.** modulo is the long name of %. Random notes 0..36 span three octaves; modulo 12 keeps only the note name (C, C#, D ...), so every note lands in the octave above middle C.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(37))[0]
fold = patch.place("modulo 12")[0]
up = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], fold.ins[0]),
    (fold.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("modulo")
```

### `pow` (`pow_`)

Computes input to the nth power

**Raising to a power.** pow raises its input to the power of its argument. 0..6 squared is 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36: above note 48, each step of the melody is wider than the last.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, pow_

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 6))[0]
square = patch.place(pow_(2))[0]
up = patch.place("+ 48")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], square.ins[0]),
    (square.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("pow")
```

### `sqrt` (`sqrt`)

Square root function

**A square-root climb.** sqrt outputs the square root of its input. 220 Hz times the roots of 1..16 climbs from 220 to 880 Hz, in big steps at first and smaller and smaller ones after.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, sqrt

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(1, 16))[0]
root = patch.place(sqrt)[0]
hz = patch.place("* 220.")[0]       # float argument: sqrt's output is a float
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], root.ins[0]),
    (root.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("sqrt")
```

### `abs` (`abs_`)

Calculate an absolute value

**Down and back up.** abs drops a number's minus sign. 0..12 minus 6 runs -6..6; abs makes that 6, 5 ... 0 ... 5, 6, so the whole-tone melody falls to note 60 and climbs back.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import abs_, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 12))[0]
centre = patch.place("- 6")[0]
size = patch.place(abs_)[0]
tone = patch.place("* 2")[0]
up = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], centre.ins[0]),
    (centre.outs[0], size.ins[0]),
    (size.outs[0], tone.ins[0]),
    (tone.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("abs")
```

### `round` (`round_`)

Round to a value

**Snapping to a grid.** round rounds to the nearest multiple of its argument. A chromatic climb 0..23 rounded to multiples of 3 becomes a staircase of minor thirds above note 60. Press ▶, then drag the number box to change the step: 1 is chromatic, 4 major thirds, 7 fifths.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number, round_

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 23))[0]
grid = patch.place(number)[0]
snap = patch.place(round_(3))[0]
up = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], snap.ins[0]),
    (grid.outs[0], snap.ins[1]),
    (snap.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("round")
```

### `maximum` (`maximum`)

Output the highest value

**A floor under the melody.** maximum outputs the larger of its input and its argument. Random notes 48..71 that fall below 60 come out as 60, so the low half of the melody turns into a repeated middle C.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, maximum, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(24))[0]
up = patch.place("+ 48")[0]
floor = patch.place(maximum(60))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], floor.ins[0]),
    (floor.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("maximum")
```

### `minimum` (`minimum`)

Output the smallest value

**A ceiling over the melody.** minimum outputs the smaller of its input and its argument. The scale climbs 60..75, but minimum 70 stops it at note 70, which repeats until the counter starts again.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, minimum, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(160, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(60, 75))[0]
ceiling = patch.place(minimum(70))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], ceiling.ins[0]),
    (ceiling.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("minimum")
```

### `scale` (`scale`)

Map values to an output range

**Map one range to another.** scale maps 0..15 onto 48..72. Here a counter's 16 steps become a two-octave climb.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, scale

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(120, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
span = patch.place(scale(0, 15, 48, 72))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], span.ins[0]),
    (span.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("scale")
```

### `zmap` (`zmap`)

Maps input range of values to output range

**Map a range, and hold the ends.** zmap maps 4..11 onto notes 60..74, like scale, but clips anything outside: counts 0..3 all play 60 and 12..15 all play 74. You hear a hold, a whole-tone climb, then a hold at the top.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, zmap

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
span = patch.place(zmap(4, 11, 60, 74))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], span.ins[0]),
    (span.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("zmap")
```

### `mtof` (`mtof`)

Convert a MIDI note number to frequency

**MIDI note to frequency.** mtof turns a MIDI note number into hertz: 60 is middle C (261.6 Hz), 69 is A (440 Hz). counter steps through 60..67.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(60, 67))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("mtof")
```

### `ftom` (`ftom`)

Convert frequency to a MIDI note number

**Tuning random frequencies.** ftom turns a frequency into the nearest MIDI note. Random frequencies 200..799 Hz are out of tune; ftom then mtof snaps each one to a piano key.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, ftom, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(600))[0]
raw = patch.place("+ 200")[0]
note = patch.place(ftom)[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], raw.ins[0]),
    (raw.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("ftom")
```

### `atodb` (`atodb`)

Convert a linear value to decibels

**Hearing the decibel curve.** atodb turns an amplitude (0..1) into decibels. Amplitudes 1/16 .. 16/16 become -24 .. 0 dB, played as notes 60..84: the pitch jumps up at first and creeps at the end, because decibels are logarithmic.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import atodb, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(1, 16))[0]
amp = patch.place("/ 16.")[0]
db = patch.place(atodb)[0]
note = patch.place("+ 84.")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (amp.outs[0], db.ins[0]),
    (db.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("atodb")
```

### `dbtoa` (`dbtoa`)

Convert decibels to a linear value

**An even fade in decibels.** dbtoa turns decibels into an amplitude for *~. Steps of -3 dB (0, -3 ... -36) make a fade that sounds even all the way down, then the tone starts loud again.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, dbtoa, ezdac_tilde, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 12))[0]
db = patch.place("* -3")[0]
amp = patch.place(dbtoa)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(330))[0]
level = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]      # the right inlet sets the volume
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], db.ins[0]),
    (db.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (amp.outs[0], level.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (level.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("dbtoa")
```

### `sin` (`sin`)

Sine function

**A melody shaped like a sine wave.** sin turns an angle (in radians) into a value from -1 to 1. Counting 0..31 in steps of 2π/32 makes one full turn, so the pitch rises and falls smoothly around note 66. Press ▶, then drag the number box to set how many semitones it swings.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number, sin

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(100, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 31))[0]
angle = patch.place("* 0.19635")[0]   # 2π / 32
wave = patch.place(sin)[0]
width = patch.place(number)[0]
depth = patch.place("* 12.")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 66.")[0]        # float arguments keep the fractions
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], angle.ins[0]),
    (angle.outs[0], wave.ins[0]),
    (wave.outs[0], depth.ins[0]),
    (width.outs[0], depth.ins[1]),
    (depth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("sin")
```

### `cos` (`cos`)

Cosine function

**A slow tremolo.** cos turns an angle into a value from -1 to 1, starting at 1. Sixteen steps make one turn; times 0.5 plus 0.5 maps that to a volume from 1 down to 0 and back, so the tone fades out and in.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cos, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(120, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
angle = patch.place("* 0.3927")[0]    # 2π / 16
wave = patch.place(cos)[0]
half = patch.place("* 0.5")[0]
lift = patch.place("+ 0.5")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(262))[0]
level = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]       # the right inlet sets the volume
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], angle.ins[0]),
    (angle.outs[0], wave.ins[0]),
    (wave.outs[0], half.ins[0]),
    (half.outs[0], lift.ins[0]),
    (lift.outs[0], level.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (level.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("cos")
```

### `tan` (`tan`)

Tangent function

**A sweep that speeds up.** tan grows faster and faster as the angle nears π/2. Angles 0 .. 1.35 give 0 .. 4.5, heard as 200 .. 645 Hz: the pitch creeps up, then shoots.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, tan

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
angle = patch.place("* 0.09")[0]
steep = patch.place(tan)[0]
width = patch.place("* 100.")[0]
hz = patch.place("+ 200.")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], angle.ins[0]),
    (angle.outs[0], steep.ins[0]),
    (steep.outs[0], width.ins[0]),
    (width.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("tan")
```

### `asin` (`asin`)

Arc-sine function

**Fast at the edges, slow in the middle.** asin is the inverse of sin: it takes -1..1 and gives the angle, -π/2..π/2. An even climb from -1 to 1 comes out as a pitch that leaps at the start and end and inches through the middle.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import asin, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, scale

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 20))[0]
unit = patch.place(scale(0, 20, -1., 1.))[0]
angle = patch.place(asin)[0]
depth = patch.place("* 8.")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 66.")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], unit.ins[0]),
    (unit.outs[0], angle.ins[0]),
    (angle.outs[0], depth.ins[0]),
    (depth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("asin")
```

### `acos` (`acos`)

Arc-cosine function

**A fall that plunges.** acos is the inverse of cos: 0 gives π/2 and 1 gives 0. Counting 0.0 .. 1.0 in tenths, the pitch falls from note 73.6 to 50, gently at first and steeply at the end.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import acos, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 10))[0]
unit = patch.place("/ 10.")[0]
angle = patch.place(acos)[0]
depth = patch.place("* 15.")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 50.")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], unit.ins[0]),
    (unit.outs[0], angle.ins[0]),
    (angle.outs[0], depth.ins[0]),
    (depth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("acos")
```

### `atan` (`atan`)

Arc-tangent function

**A leap that levels off.** atan gives the angle whose tangent is its input, never more than π/2. For 0..15 it shoots up from 0 then flattens near 1.5, so the melody leaps from note 54 and then barely moves.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import atan, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
angle = patch.place(atan)[0]
depth = patch.place("* 16.")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 54.")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], angle.ins[0]),
    (angle.outs[0], depth.ins[0]),
    (depth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("atan")
```

### `atan2` (`atan2`)

Two-variable arc-tangent function

**An S-shaped sweep.** atan2 gives the angle of the point (x, y): y in the left inlet, x in the right. With x = 2 and y counting -8..8, the angle climbs slowly, rushes through the middle, and slows again. Press ▶, then drag the number box to set x: 0 jumps between two notes, larger values smooth the curve.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import atan2, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 16))[0]
y = patch.place("- 8")[0]
x = patch.place(number)[0]
angle = patch.place(atan2(2.))[0]
depth = patch.place("* 9.")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 66.")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], y.ins[0]),
    (y.outs[0], angle.ins[0]),
    (x.outs[0], angle.ins[1]),
    (angle.outs[0], depth.ins[0]),
    (depth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("atan2")
```

### `sinh` (`sinh`)

Hyperbolic sine function

**A slow start, then a rocket.** sinh (hyperbolic sine) grows almost exponentially. Inputs 0 .. 3 give 0 .. 10, heard as 200 .. 600 Hz: barely moving at first, then racing upward.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, sinh

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
unit = patch.place("/ 5.")[0]
grow = patch.place(sinh)[0]
width = patch.place("* 40.")[0]
hz = patch.place("+ 200.")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], unit.ins[0]),
    (unit.outs[0], grow.ins[0]),
    (grow.outs[0], width.ins[0]),
    (width.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("sinh")
```

### `cosh` (`cosh`)

Hyperbolic cosine function

**A smooth U-turn.** cosh (hyperbolic cosine) is 1 at 0 and grows on both sides, the curve of a hanging chain. Inputs -2 .. 2 give a pitch that falls fast, slows to 200 Hz at the bottom, and climbs back to 750 Hz.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cosh, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 16))[0]
centre = patch.place("- 8")[0]
unit = patch.place("/ 4.")[0]
chain = patch.place(cosh)[0]
hz = patch.place("* 200.")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], centre.ins[0]),
    (centre.outs[0], unit.ins[0]),
    (unit.outs[0], chain.ins[0]),
    (chain.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("cosh")
```

### `tanh` (`tanh`)

Hyperbolic tangent function

**A swell that saturates.** tanh (hyperbolic tangent) rises steeply, then flattens just under 1. Used as a volume, 0 .. 5 makes the tone swell quickly and then hold, never going past full level.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, tanh

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
unit = patch.place("/ 3.")[0]
soft = patch.place(tanh)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(294))[0]
level = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]       # the right inlet sets the volume
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], unit.ins[0]),
    (unit.outs[0], soft.ins[0]),
    (soft.outs[0], level.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (level.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("tanh")
```

### `asinh` (`asinh`)

Hyperbolic arc-sine function

**Opening a filter.** asinh (inverse hyperbolic sine) grows like a logarithm. It sets lores~'s cutoff over a 110 Hz sawtooth: from 200 Hz the sound brightens quickly, then more and more slowly up to about 3000 Hz.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import asinh, counter, ezdac_tilde, lores_tilde, metro, saw_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
spread = patch.place("* 20")[0]
curve = patch.place(asinh)[0]          # 0 .. 5.7
width = patch.place("* 500.")[0]
cutoff = patch.place("+ 200.")[0]
saw = patch.place(saw_tilde(110))[0]
filt = patch.place(lores_tilde(200, 0.3))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], spread.ins[0]),
    (spread.outs[0], curve.ins[0]),
    (curve.outs[0], width.ins[0]),
    (width.outs[0], cutoff.ins[0]),
    (cutoff.outs[0], filt.ins[1]),
    (saw.outs[0], filt.ins[0]),
    (filt.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("asinh")
```

### `acosh` (`acosh`)

Hyperbolic arc-cosine function

**Big steps, then small.** acosh (inverse hyperbolic cosine) takes numbers from 1 up and grows like a logarithm. For 1..16 the melody jumps up from note 55 and then climbs in ever smaller steps.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import acosh, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(1, 16))[0]
curve = patch.place(acosh)[0]          # 0 .. 3.47
depth = patch.place("* 7.")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 55.")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], curve.ins[0]),
    (curve.outs[0], depth.ins[0]),
    (depth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("acosh")
```

### `atanh` (`atanh`)

Hyperbolic arc-tangent function

**Racing toward the edges.** atanh (inverse hyperbolic tangent) takes -1..1 and runs off toward infinity near the ends. -0.9 .. 0.9 in even steps becomes a pitch that leaps at both ends and drifts through the middle.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import atanh, counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, scale

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 18))[0]
unit = patch.place(scale(0, 18, -0.9, 0.9))[0]
curve = patch.place(atanh)[0]
depth = patch.place("* 8.")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 66.")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], unit.ins[0]),
    (unit.outs[0], curve.ins[0]),
    (curve.outs[0], depth.ins[0]),
    (depth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("atanh")
```

### `mean` (`mean`)

Calculate a running average

**A melody that settles.** mean outputs the average of every number it has received. Random notes 60..83 play in the left ear; their running mean plays in the right, wandering at first and settling near note 71.5.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, mean, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(24))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
avg = patch.place(mean)[0]
hz1 = patch.place(mtof)[0]
hz2 = patch.place(mtof)[0]
```
