```python
left = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
right = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet1 = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
quiet2 = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz1.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], avg.ins[0]),
    (avg.outs[0], hz2.ins[0]),
    (hz1.outs[0], left.ins[0]),
    (hz2.outs[0], right.ins[0]),
    (left.outs[0], quiet1.ins[0]),
    (right.outs[0], quiet2.ins[0]),
    (quiet1.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet2.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("mean")
```

## Logic

Compare numbers and combine true/false values.

### `equals` (`equals`)

Compare numbers for equal-to condition

**Is it this beat?.** == outputs 1 when its input equals its argument, otherwise 0. Beat 0 of every eight gives 1, times 12 an octave up, so the bar starts on a high note. Press ▶, then drag the number box (0..7) to move the high note to another beat.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
beat = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
which = patch.place(number)[0]
match = patch.place("== 0")[0]
octave = patch.place("* 12")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], beat.ins[0]),
    (beat.outs[0], match.ins[0]),
    (which.outs[0], match.ins[1]),
    (match.outs[0], octave.ins[0]),
    (octave.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("equals")
```

**A random rhythm.** equals is the long name of ==. random picks 0..3 on every tick, and equals 2 outputs 1 only when it picks 2; as the volume of *~, that lets through about one tick in four.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(125, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(4))[0]
hit = patch.place("equals 2")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(440))[0]
gate = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]       # 1 lets the tone through, 0 silences it
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], hit.ins[0]),
    (hit.outs[0], gate.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], gate.ins[0]),
    (gate.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("equals")
```

### `notequals` (`notequals`)

Compare numbers for not-equal-to condition

**Three beats on, one off.** != outputs 1 when its input differs from its argument. Counting 0..3, != 3 gives 1 1 1 0; as the volume of *~, the tone plays three beats and rests on the fourth. Press ▶, then drag the number box (0..3) to move the rest.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
beat = patch.place(counter(0, 3))[0]
rest = patch.place(number)[0]
play = patch.place("!= 3")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(330))[0]
gate = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]       # 1 lets the tone through, 0 silences it
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], beat.ins[0]),
    (beat.outs[0], play.ins[0]),
    (rest.outs[0], play.ins[1]),
    (play.outs[0], gate.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], gate.ins[0]),
    (gate.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("notequals")
```

**Mostly high, sometimes low.** notequals is the long name of !=. random picks 0..4, and notequals 0 is 1 four times in five: times 7 plus 53 plays middle C (60) mostly, and the F below (53) when random picks 0.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(5))[0]
high = patch.place("notequals 0")[0]
fifth = patch.place("* 7")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 53")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], high.ins[0]),
    (high.outs[0], fifth.ins[0]),
    (fifth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("notequals")
```

### `greaterthan` (`greaterthan`)

Compare numbers for greater than condition

**Sometimes a fifth higher.** > outputs 1 when its input is greater than its argument. random picks 0..99, and > 70 is 1 about 30% of the time: those ticks jump from middle C up a fifth. Press ▶, then drag the number box to set the threshold: higher means fewer jumps.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(160, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(100))[0]
threshold = patch.place(number)[0]
above = patch.place("> 70")[0]
fifth = patch.place("* 7")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], above.ins[0]),
    (threshold.outs[0], above.ins[1]),
    (above.outs[0], fifth.ins[0]),
    (fifth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("greaterthan")
```

**Brighter at the end of the phrase.** greaterthan is the long name of >. Counting 0..15, greaterthan 11 is 1 for the last four steps, which opens lores~ from 300 to 2300 Hz: the buzzy sawtooth turns bright, then dark again.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, ezdac_tilde, lores_tilde, metro, saw_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
late = patch.place("greaterthan 11")[0]
open_ = patch.place("* 2000")[0]
cutoff = patch.place("+ 300")[0]
saw = patch.place(saw_tilde(110))[0]
filt = patch.place(lores_tilde(300, 0.3))[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], late.ins[0]),
    (late.outs[0], open_.ins[0]),
    (open_.outs[0], cutoff.ins[0]),
    (cutoff.outs[0], filt.ins[1]),
    (saw.outs[0], filt.ins[0]),
    (filt.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("greaterthan")
```

### `greaterthaneq` (`greaterthaneq`)

Compare numbers for greater than or equal to condition

**Louder from middle C up.** >= outputs 1 when its input is greater than or equal to its argument. A chromatic climb 48..72 plays softly until it reaches 60, where >= 60 turns 1 and the volume jumps up (scale maps 0 and 1 to 0.25 and 1). Press ▶, then drag the number box to move the point where it gets loud.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number, scale

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(48, 72))[0]
point = patch.place(number)[0]
high = patch.place(">= 60")[0]
volume = patch.place(scale(0, 1, 0.25, 1.))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
level = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]      # the right inlet sets the volume
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], high.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (point.outs[0], high.ins[1]),
    (high.outs[0], volume.ins[0]),
    (volume.outs[0], level.ins[1]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (level.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("greaterthaneq")
```

**A coin toss between octaves.** greaterthaneq is the long name of >=. random picks 0..99 and greaterthaneq 50 is 1 half the time: times 12 plus 57 hops at random between A 57 and the A an octave up.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(100))[0]
heads = patch.place("greaterthaneq 50")[0]
octave = patch.place("* 12")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 57")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], heads.ins[0]),
    (heads.outs[0], octave.ins[0]),
    (octave.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("greaterthaneq")
```

### `lessthan` (`lessthan`)

Compare numbers for less than condition

**Two halves of a bar.** < outputs 1 while its input is less than its argument. Counting 0..7, < 4 is 1 for the first four beats and 0 for the rest, so the bar plays note 65 four times and then 60 four times.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
beat = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
early = patch.place("< 4")[0]
fourth = patch.place("* 5")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], beat.ins[0]),
    (beat.outs[0], early.ins[0]),
    (early.outs[0], fourth.ins[0]),
    (fourth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("lessthan")
```

**How busy is the rhythm?.** lessthan is the long name of <. random picks 0..99; lessthan 30 is 1 about 30% of the time, and that opens the tone, so roughly three ticks in ten play. Press ▶, then drag the number box (0..100) to set the percentage.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, number, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(100, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(100))[0]
density = patch.place(number)[0]
chance = patch.place("lessthan 30")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(523))[0]
gate = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]       # 1 lets the tone through, 0 silences it
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], chance.ins[0]),
    (density.outs[0], chance.ins[1]),
    (chance.outs[0], gate.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], gate.ins[0]),
    (gate.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("lessthan")
```

### `lessthaneq` (`lessthaneq`)

Compare numbers as less than or equal to

**Accents at the start of the bar.** <= outputs 1 while its input is less than or equal to its argument. Counting 0..7, <= 1 is 1 on the first two beats; times 0.7 plus 0.3 makes those loud and the rest soft. Press ▶, then drag the number box to accent more beats.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
beat = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
last = patch.place(number)[0]
accent = patch.place("<= 1")[0]
boost = patch.place("* 0.7")[0]
soft = patch.place("+ 0.3")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(392))[0]
level = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]      # the right inlet sets the volume
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], beat.ins[0]),
    (beat.outs[0], accent.ins[0]),
    (last.outs[0], accent.ins[1]),
    (accent.outs[0], boost.ins[0]),
    (boost.outs[0], soft.ins[0]),
    (soft.outs[0], level.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], level.ins[0]),
    (level.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("lessthaneq")
```

**Lifting the low notes.** lessthaneq is the long name of <=. trigger sends each random note out of its right outlet first: lessthaneq 65 gives 1 for notes up to 65, and times 12 stores 12 or 0 in the cold inlet of + 0. Then the note goes left into + 0, so the low notes play an octave up.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(24))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 54")[0]
both = patch.place(trigger("i", "i"))[0]
low = patch.place("lessthaneq 65")[0]
octave = patch.place("* 12")[0]
lift = patch.place("+ 0")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], both.ins[0]),
    (both.outs[1], low.ins[0]),       # right outlet fires first
    (low.outs[0], octave.ins[0]),
    (octave.outs[0], lift.ins[1]),
    (both.outs[0], lift.ins[0]),
    (lift.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("lessthaneq")
```

### `logand` (`logand`)

Perform a logical AND

**Both conditions at once.** && outputs 1 only when both inlets are non-zero. trigger sends each beat right first, to % 2 (1 on odd beats) into the cold inlet, then left to > 3 (1 in the second half): only beats 5 and 7 are both, and jump an octave.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, scale, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
beat = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
both = patch.place(trigger("i", "i"))[0]
odd = patch.place("% 2")[0]
late = patch.place("> 3")[0]
and_ = patch.place("&& 0")[0]
note = patch.place(scale(0, 1, 60, 72))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], beat.ins[0]),
    (beat.outs[0], both.ins[0]),
    (both.outs[1], odd.ins[0]),       # right outlet fires first
    (odd.outs[0], and_.ins[1]),
    (both.outs[0], late.ins[0]),
    (late.outs[0], and_.ins[0]),
    (and_.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("logand")
```

**Two coins, both heads.** logand is the long name of &&. On each tick two random 0-or-1 coins go into logand (the right one first, into the cold inlet). It is 1 only when both are heads, so the tone plays about one tick in four.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, random, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(120, active=1))[0]
twice = patch.place(trigger("b", "b"))[0]
coin1 = patch.place(random(2))[0]
coin2 = patch.place(random(2))[0]
heads = patch.place("logand 0")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(587))[0]
gate = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]       # 1 lets the tone through, 0 silences it
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], twice.ins[0]),
    (twice.outs[1], coin2.ins[0]),
    (coin2.outs[0], heads.ins[1]),
    (twice.outs[0], coin1.ins[0]),
    (coin1.outs[0], heads.ins[0]),
    (heads.outs[0], gate.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], gate.ins[0]),
    (gate.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("logand")
```

### `logor` (`logor`)

Perform a logical OR

**A pickup into the downbeat.** || outputs 1 when either inlet is non-zero. trigger sends each beat right first, to > 5 (beats 6 and 7) into the cold inlet, then left to < 1 (beat 0): beats 6, 7 and 0 jump an octave, leading into each bar.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, scale, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
beat = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
both = patch.place(trigger("i", "i"))[0]
end = patch.place("> 5")[0]
start = patch.place("< 1")[0]
or_ = patch.place("|| 0")[0]
note = patch.place(scale(0, 1, 62, 74))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], beat.ins[0]),
    (beat.outs[0], both.ins[0]),
    (both.outs[1], end.ins[0]),       # right outlet fires first
    (end.outs[0], or_.ins[1]),
    (both.outs[0], start.ins[0]),
    (start.outs[0], or_.ins[0]),
    (or_.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("logor")
```

**Two coins, either heads.** logor is the long name of ||. On each tick two random 0-or-1 coins go into logor (the right one first, into the cold inlet). It is 1 when either is heads, so the tone plays about three ticks in four.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, random, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(120, active=1))[0]
twice = patch.place(trigger("b", "b"))[0]
coin1 = patch.place(random(2))[0]
coin2 = patch.place(random(2))[0]
either = patch.place("logor 0")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(440))[0]
gate = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]       # 1 lets the tone through, 0 silences it
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], twice.ins[0]),
    (twice.outs[1], coin2.ins[0]),
    (coin2.outs[0], either.ins[1]),
    (twice.outs[0], coin1.ins[0]),
    (coin1.outs[0], either.ins[0]),
    (either.outs[0], gate.ins[1]),
    (osc.outs[0], gate.ins[0]),
    (gate.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("logor")
```

### `bitand` (`bitand`)

Bitwise intersection of two numbers

**Masking bits into a pattern.** & keeps only the bits that are also set in its argument. Counting 0..7, & 5 (binary 101) gives 0 1 0 1 4 5 4 5; times 2 above note 60 that is a little two-part figure. Press ▶, then drag the number box (0..7) to try other masks.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
mask = patch.place(number)[0]
bits = patch.place("& 5")[0]
tone = patch.place("* 2")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], bits.ins[0]),
    (mask.outs[0], bits.ins[1]),
    (bits.outs[0], tone.ins[0]),
    (tone.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("bitand")
```

**One bit, a slower beat.** bitand is the long name of &. bitand 4 keeps only the 4s bit of the count, which is off for 0..3 and on for 4..7: four notes on C, then four on the E above, over and over.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 15))[0]
bit = patch.place("bitand 4")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], bit.ins[0]),
    (bit.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("bitand")
```

### `bitor` (`bitor`)

Bitwise union of two numbers

**Forcing a bit on.** | sets every bit of its argument in its input. Counting 0..7, | 4 gives 4 5 6 7 4 5 6 7: the first half of the climb is lifted onto the second, so you hear the same four notes twice. Press ▶, then drag the number box (0..7) to set other bits.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
force = patch.place(number)[0]
bits = patch.place("| 4")[0]
tone = patch.place("* 2")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 58")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], bits.ins[0]),
    (force.outs[0], bits.ins[1]),
    (bits.outs[0], tone.ins[0]),
    (tone.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("bitor")
```

**Only odd notes.** bitor is the long name of |. bitor 1 turns on the lowest bit, so every random number 0..11 becomes odd: above note 60 that leaves 61, 63, 65, 67, 69, 71, a whole-tone scale.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(12))[0]
odd = patch.place("bitor 1")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], odd.ins[0]),
    (odd.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("bitor")
```

## Timing

Make things happen at the right moment.

### `metro` (`metro`)

Output a bang message at regular intervals

**A clock that plays notes.** metro sends a bang every 250 ms. counter counts 0 to 7, + 60 turns that into MIDI notes, and mtof into hertz for cycle~.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]   # @active 1: starts on its own
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]                  # 60 is middle C
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("metro")
```

**Two clocks against each other.** Two metros at 300 ms and 400 ms drift in and out of step, a 3-against-4 rhythm. Each picks a note for its own oscillator.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
fast = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
slow = patch.place(metro(400, active=1))[0]
pick_a = patch.place(random(5))[0]
pick_b = patch.place(random(5))[0]
note_a = patch.place("* 2")[0]
note_b = patch.place("* 3")[0]
up_a = patch.place("+ 64")[0]
up_b = patch.place("+ 52")[0]
hz_a = patch.place(mtof)[0]
hz_b = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc_a = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
osc_b = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
mix = patch.place("+~")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.15")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect((fast.outs[0], pick_a.ins[0]), (pick_a.outs[0], note_a.ins[0]),
              (note_a.outs[0], up_a.ins[0]), (up_a.outs[0], hz_a.ins[0]), (hz_a.outs[0], osc_a.ins[0]))
patch.connect((slow.outs[0], pick_b.ins[0]), (pick_b.outs[0], note_b.ins[0]),
              (note_b.outs[0], up_b.ins[0]), (up_b.outs[0], hz_b.ins[0]), (hz_b.outs[0], osc_b.ins[0]))
patch.connect((osc_a.outs[0], mix.ins[0]), (osc_b.outs[0], mix.ins[1]), (mix.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
              (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]))
patch.save("polyrhythm")
```

### `qmetro` (`qmetro`)

Queue-based metronome

**A metro for the screen.** qmetro bangs like metro, but at low priority, so it is the clock for drawing and video. Here every 200 ms it steps a counter through a stack of fourths. Press ▶, then type a new interval into the number box.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, mtof, number, qmetro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
rate = patch.place(number)[0]
clock = patch.place(qmetro(200, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 4))[0]
fourths = patch.place("* 5")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 55")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (rate.outs[0], clock.ins[1]),      # right inlet: the interval in ms
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], fourths.ins[0]),
    (fourths.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("qmetro")
```

### `delay` (`delay`)

Delay a bang

**A bang, later.** delay sends a bang after a time (its argument is required). Each beat plays note 60, and 150 ms later note 67.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, delay, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(600, active=1))[0]
now = patch.place("message 60")[0]
wait = patch.place(delay(150))[0]
later = patch.place("message 67")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], now.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], wait.ins[0]),
    (wait.outs[0], later.ins[0]),
    (now.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (later.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("delay")
```

### `pipe` (`pipe`)

Delay numbers, lists or symbols

**Delaying numbers.** pipe holds each number for a time (200 ms) before sending it on. Each step plays, then a fifth above it plays 200 ms later.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, pipe

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(400, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(57, 62))[0]
fifth = patch.place("+ 7")[0]
later = patch.place(pipe(200))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], fifth.ins[0]),
    (fifth.outs[0], later.ins[0]),
    (later.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("pipe")
```

### `line` (`line`)

Generate timed ramp

**A glide between numbers.** line outputs a stream of numbers ramping to a target. "220, 880 1500" jumps to 220, then glides to 880 over 1.5 seconds, every 2 seconds.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(2000, active=1))[0]
glide = patch.place("message 220, 880 1500")[0]
ramp = patch.place(line)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], glide.ins[0]),
    (glide.outs[0], ramp.ins[0]),
    (ramp.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("glide")
```

### `tempo` (`tempo`)

Output numbers at a metronomic tempo

**A clock in beats per minute.** tempo counts 0 to 7 in eighth notes at 60 BPM (its arguments: tempo, multiplier, division), once loadmess starts it. Each count, times 5, walks the notes around a circle of fourths. Press ▶, then type a new BPM into the number box.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, loadmess, mtof, number, tempo

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadmess(1))[0]
bpm = patch.place(number)[0]
clock = patch.place(tempo(60, 1, 8))[0]
wrap = patch.place("% 8")[0]
fourths = patch.place("* 5")[0]
fold = patch.place("% 12")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], clock.ins[0]),     # 1 starts it, 0 stops it
    (bpm.outs[0], clock.ins[1]), (clock.outs[0], wrap.ins[0]), (wrap.outs[0], fourths.ins[0]),
    (fourths.outs[0], fold.ins[0]), (fold.outs[0], note.ins[0]), (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("tempo")
```

### `clocker` (`clocker`)

Report elapsed time, at regular intervals

**How long since it started.** clocker reports the milliseconds since it was started, every 50 ms. % 2000 turns that into a sawtooth from 0 to 1999, and scale into a pitch that climbs from 200 to 800 Hz and starts over every 2 seconds.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import clocker, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, loadmess, scale

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadmess(1))[0]
clock = patch.place(clocker(50))[0]     # report interval, ms
wrap = patch.place("% 2000")[0]
hz = patch.place(scale(0, 2000, 200, 800))[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], clock.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], wrap.ins[0]),
    (wrap.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("clocker")
```

### `uzi` (`uzi`)

Send many bang messages

**Many bangs at once.** uzi sends a burst of bangs, all in the same instant. Each beat it bangs the counter 3 times, so the note jumps 3 semitones: a diminished arpeggio. Press ▶, then type another burst size into the number box.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number, uzi

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(400, active=1))[0]
size = patch.place(number)[0]
burst = patch.place(uzi(3))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 11))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], burst.ins[0]),
    (size.outs[0], burst.ins[1]),      # right inlet: how many, without firing
    (burst.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("uzi")
```

### `speedlim` (`speedlim`)

Limit the speed of message throughput

**Slow a fast stream down.** The counter climbs a semitone every 30 ms, too fast to hear as notes. speedlim lets at most one number through every 250 ms, so you hear a few steps of the climb. Press ▶, then type a new limit (ms) into the number box.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number, speedlim

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(30, active=1))[0]
climb = patch.place(counter(48, 84))[0]
limit = patch.place(number)[0]
slow = patch.place(speedlim(250))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], climb.ins[0]),
    (climb.outs[0], slow.ins[0]),
    (limit.outs[0], slow.ins[1]),
    (slow.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("speedlim")
```

## Control flow

Decide where a message goes and in what order.

### `trigger` (`trigger`)

Send input to many places

**Right to left, in order.** trigger sends its input out of each outlet, right first. Here the note goes right to a delay and left to play now, so each note is followed by its octave.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, pipe, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(400, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(60, 64))[0]
both = patch.place(trigger("i", "i"))[0]
later = patch.place(pipe(150))[0]
octave = patch.place("+ 12")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], both.ins[0]),
    (both.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (both.outs[1], octave.ins[0]),
    (octave.outs[0], later.ins[0]),
    (later.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("trigger")
```

**t: pick the octave first.** t is short for trigger. "t i b" bangs its right outlet first: random picks 0 or 12 into the cold right inlet of +, and only then the note arrives at the hot left inlet. So the melody jumps octaves at random, never a beat late.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(60, 67))[0]
order = patch.place("t i b")[0]
coin = patch.place(random(2))[0]
octave = patch.place("* 12")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 0")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]), (step.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], coin.ins[0]),      # right outlet fires first
    (coin.outs[0], octave.ins[0]),
    (octave.outs[0], note.ins[1]),     # cold: stored, no output
    (order.outs[0], note.ins[0]),      # hot: adds and outputs
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("t")
```

### `select` (`select`)

Output bangs based on input matching

**Do something on one value.** select sends a bang out of its left outlet when its input matches (0), and passes other values out of the right. The first beat of every four is an octave higher.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, select

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
beat = patch.place(counter(0, 3))[0]
first = patch.place(select(0))[0]
high = patch.place("message 72")[0]
low = patch.place("message 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], beat.ins[0]),
    (beat.outs[0], first.ins[0]),
    (first.outs[0], high.ins[0]),
    (first.outs[1], low.ins[0]),
    (high.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (low.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("select")
```

**sel: a rhythm from three numbers.** sel is short for select. "sel 0 3 6" bangs on steps 0, 3 and 6 of an 8-step count, and each bang starts a short noise burst: the 3 + 3 + 2 rhythm.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro, noise_tilde

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
hits = patch.place("sel 0 3 6")[0]
burst = patch.place("message 1 2 0 120")[0]    # up in 2 ms, down in 120
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
hiss = patch.place(noise_tilde)[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]), (step.outs[0], hits.ins[0]), (hits.outs[0], burst.ins[0]),
    (hits.outs[1], burst.ins[0]), (hits.outs[2], burst.ins[0]), (burst.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (hiss.outs[0], amp.ins[0]), (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]), (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("sel")
```

### `route` (`route`)

Select outlet based on input matching

**Sort messages by their first word.** route looks at a message's first word, strips it, and sends the rest out the matching outlet. Notes tagged "bass" play low (+ 36) and notes tagged "lead" high (+ 72), each on its own oscillator.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, prepend, random, route

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
slow = patch.place(metro(500, active=1))[0]
fast = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
pick_a = patch.place(random(8))[0]
pick_b = patch.place(random(8))[0]
tag_a = patch.place(prepend("bass"))[0]
tag_b = patch.place(prepend("lead"))[0]
sort = patch.place(route("bass", "lead"))[0]
low = patch.place("+ 36")[0]
high = patch.place("+ 72")[0]
hz_a = patch.place(mtof)[0]
hz_b = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc_a = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
osc_b = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.15")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect((slow.outs[0], pick_a.ins[0]), (pick_a.outs[0], tag_a.ins[0]), (tag_a.outs[0], sort.ins[0]),
              (fast.outs[0], pick_b.ins[0]), (pick_b.outs[0], tag_b.ins[0]), (tag_b.outs[0], sort.ins[0]),
              (sort.outs[0], low.ins[0]), (low.outs[0], hz_a.ins[0]), (hz_a.outs[0], osc_a.ins[0]),
              (sort.outs[1], high.ins[0]), (high.outs[0], hz_b.ins[0]), (hz_b.outs[0], osc_b.ins[0]),
              (osc_a.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (osc_b.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),   # signals into one inlet add
              (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]))
patch.save("route")
```

### `routepass` (`routepass`)

Route a complete incoming message based on input matching

**Let only some notes through.** routepass is route that keeps the matched word: 60, 64 or 67 comes out whole (route would send only a bang). The counter climbs a semitone at a time, and only the notes of a C major chord reach the oscillator.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, routepass

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
climb = patch.place(counter(60, 71))[0]
chord = patch.place(routepass(60, 64, 67))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], climb.ins[0]),
    (climb.outs[0], chord.ins[0]),
    (chord.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (chord.outs[1], hz.ins[0]),
    (chord.outs[2], hz.ins[0]),        # outs[3], the other notes, goes nowhere
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("routepass")
```

### `gate` (`gate`)

Pass input to an outlet

**Send notes one way or another.** gate 2 1 has two outlets and starts with the first open: random notes go to + 60. The left inlet picks the outlet (0 closes it), so the toggle, plus 1, chooses outlet 1 or 2. Press ▶, then click the toggle to send the notes up an octave.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, gate, metro, mtof, random, toggle

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
flip = patch.place(toggle)[0]
which = patch.place("+ 1")[0]
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(8))[0]
door = patch.place(gate(2, 1))[0]      # 2 outlets, outlet 1 open
low = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
high = patch.place("+ 72")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (flip.outs[0], which.ins[0]), (which.outs[0], door.ins[0]), (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], door.ins[1]), (door.outs[0], low.ins[0]), (door.outs[1], high.ins[0]),
    (low.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (high.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("gate")
```

### `switch` (`switch`)

Accept messages from a specific inlet

**Listen to one of two melodies.** switch passes one of its inlets to its outlet: the left inlet chooses which (1 or 2; 0 shuts it). loadmess picks the climbing scale; the toggle, plus 1, picks it or the random notes. Press ▶, then click the toggle to switch melodies.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, loadmess, metro, mtof, random, switch, toggle

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadmess(1))[0]
flip = patch.place(toggle)[0]
which = patch.place("+ 1")[0]
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
scale_up = patch.place(counter(60, 72))[0]
wander = patch.place(random(24))[0]
pitch = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
pick = patch.place(switch)[0]          # two inlets to choose from
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], pick.ins[0]), (flip.outs[0], which.ins[0]), (which.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], scale_up.ins[0]), (clock.outs[0], wander.ins[0]),
    (wander.outs[0], pitch.ins[0]), (scale_up.outs[0], pick.ins[1]), (pitch.outs[0], pick.ins[2]),
    (pick.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("switch")
```

### `gswitch` (`gswitch`)

Select output from two inlets

**A switch you can see.** gswitch draws which of its two data inlets reaches the outlet; a bang in its left inlet flips it. A slow metro flips it every 2 seconds, between a climbing scale and random notes.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, gswitch, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
flipper = patch.place(metro(2000, active=1))[0]
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
scale_up = patch.place(counter(60, 72))[0]
wander = patch.place(random(24))[0]
pitch = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
pick = patch.place(gswitch)[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (flipper.outs[0], pick.ins[0]), (clock.outs[0], scale_up.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], wander.ins[0]), (wander.outs[0], pitch.ins[0]),
    (scale_up.outs[0], pick.ins[1]), (pitch.outs[0], pick.ins[2]), (pick.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("gswitch")
```

### `router` (`router`)

Route messages to multiple locations

**Switching between two inputs.** router passes each message from a data inlet to every outlet that inlet is connected to; inlets and outlets are numbered from 0. A scale goes into inlet 0 and the same scale an octave up into inlet 1. Every 1.6 seconds "patch 0 0" or "patch 1 0" connects one of them to outlet 0 and cuts the other, so the scale jumps between octaves.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, router, select

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
scale = patch.place(counter(60, 67))[0]
up = patch.place("+ 12")[0]
slow = patch.place(metro(1600, active=1))[0]
which = patch.place(counter(0, 1))[0]
pick = patch.place(select(0, 1))[0]
low = patch.place("message patch 0 0")[0]
high = patch.place("message patch 1 0")[0]
patchbay = patch.place(router(2, 1))[0]   # 2 data inlets, 1 outlet
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (slow.outs[0], which.ins[0]),
    (which.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], low.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[1], high.ins[0]),
    (low.outs[0], patchbay.ins[0]),       # the left inlet takes patch / connect / clear
    (high.outs[0], patchbay.ins[0]),
    (clock.outs[0], scale.ins[0]),
    (scale.outs[0], patchbay.ins[1]),     # data inlet 0
    (scale.outs[0], up.ins[0]),
    (up.outs[0], patchbay.ins[2]),        # data inlet 1
    (patchbay.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("router")
```

### `onebang` (`onebang`)

Gate bangs using a bang

**One bang, then wait.** onebang lets one bang through its left inlet, then shuts until its right inlet gets a bang. A fast 100 ms metro knocks on it and a 1 s metro reopens it, so a new random note sounds about once a second, on the fast grid.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, onebang, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
fast = patch.place(metro(100, active=1))[0]
reopen = patch.place(metro(1000, active=1))[0]
once = patch.place(onebang(1))[0]      # 1: starts open
pick = patch.place(random(12))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (fast.outs[0], once.ins[0]),
    (reopen.outs[0], once.ins[1]),
    (once.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("onebang")
```

### `change` (`change`)

Filter out repetitions of a number

**Only new notes start a sound.** random picks one of 3 notes every 125 ms, so it often repeats. change passes a number only when it differs from the last, so repeats are silent and only new notes are plucked: an uneven rhythm from a steady clock.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import change, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(125, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(3))[0]
new = patch.place(change)[0]
order = patch.place("t b i")[0]
note = patch.place("* 5")[0]
base = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
pluck = patch.place("message 1 5 0 250")[0]
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]), (pick.outs[0], new.ins[0]), (new.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], note.ins[0]), (note.outs[0], base.ins[0]), (base.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[0], pluck.ins[0]), (pluck.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]), (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("change")
```

### `counter` (`counter`)

Keep count based on bang messages

**Counting up.** counter outputs 0, 1, 2, 3, 0, ... on each bang. Times 4 plus 60 plays a rising arpeggio of notes 60, 64, 68, 72.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(180, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 3))[0]
times = patch.place("* 4")[0]
plus = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], times.ins[0]),
    (times.outs[0], plus.ins[0]),
    (plus.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("counter")
```

### `accum` (`accum`)

Store, add to, and multiply a number

**Keep adding.** accum's middle inlet adds to the number it holds; a bang in the left inlet outputs it. Each beat adds 7 semitones, then sends the total: % 12 folds it into one octave, so the notes walk the circle of fifths.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import accum, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
order = patch.place("t b b")[0]
fifth = patch.place("message 7")[0]
total = patch.place(accum(0))[0]
fold = patch.place("% 12")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], fifth.ins[0]),     # right first: add 7
    (fifth.outs[0], total.ins[1]),
    (order.outs[0], total.ins[0]),     # then output the total
    (total.outs[0], fold.ins[0]), (fold.outs[0], note.ins[0]), (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("accum")
```

### `peak` (`peak`)

Output larger numbers

**Only ever higher.** peak outputs a number only when it is the highest so far, so the random notes can only climb. Every 3 seconds a 0 into its right inlet resets the peak, and the climb starts again.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, peak, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
reset = patch.place(metro(3000, active=1))[0]
zero = patch.place("message 0")[0]
pick = patch.place(random(24))[0]
top = patch.place(peak)[0]
note = patch.place("+ 52")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (reset.outs[0], zero.ins[0]),
    (zero.outs[0], top.ins[1]),        # sets the peak, no output
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]), (pick.outs[0], top.ins[0]), (top.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("peak")
```

### `trough` (`trough`)

Output a number if it is less than previous numbers

**Only ever lower.** trough outputs a number only when it is the lowest so far, so the random notes can only fall. Every 3 seconds a 24 into its right inlet resets the trough, and the fall starts again from the top.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random, trough

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
reset = patch.place(metro(3000, active=1))[0]
top = patch.place("message 24")[0]
pick = patch.place(random(24))[0]
low = patch.place(trough)[0]
note = patch.place("+ 52")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (reset.outs[0], top.ins[0]),
    (top.outs[0], low.ins[1]),         # sets the trough, no output
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]), (pick.outs[0], low.ins[0]), (low.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("trough")
```

### `split` (`split`)

Look for a range of numbers

**Two sounds by range.** split 60 71 sends numbers from 60 to 71 out its left outlet and all others out its right. Random notes in that octave play on the smooth cycle~, the rest on the buzzy saw~.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, random, saw_tilde, split

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(36))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 48")[0]
middle = patch.place(split(60, 71))[0]
hz_in = patch.place(mtof)[0]
hz_out = patch.place(mtof)[0]
smooth = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
buzzy = patch.place(saw_tilde)[0]
soft = patch.place("*~ 0.3")[0]
mix = patch.place("+~")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]), (pick.outs[0], note.ins[0]), (note.outs[0], middle.ins[0]),
    (middle.outs[0], hz_in.ins[0]), (hz_in.outs[0], smooth.ins[0]),
    (middle.outs[1], hz_out.ins[0]), (hz_out.outs[0], buzzy.ins[0]), (buzzy.outs[0], soft.ins[0]),
    (smooth.outs[0], mix.ins[0]), (soft.outs[0], mix.ins[1]),
    (mix.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("split")
```

### `swap` (`swap`)

Swap position of two numbers

**Swap the order.** swap sends its left-inlet number out the RIGHT outlet first, then its stored right-inlet number out the left. Crossed into -, that makes 72 minus the count: a scale falling from 72. Press ▶, then type a new top note into the number box.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, number, swap

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
top = patch.place(number)[0]
cross = patch.place(swap(72))[0]
minus = patch.place("- 0")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], cross.ins[0]),
    (top.outs[0], cross.ins[1]),
    (cross.outs[1], minus.ins[1]),     # the count, first, into the cold inlet
    (cross.outs[0], minus.ins[0]),     # then 72 into the hot one
    (minus.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("swap")
```

### `bangbang` (`bangbang`)

Output a bang from many outlets

**Bangs in a fixed order.** bangbang sends a bang out each outlet, right to left, whatever comes in. The right bang picks the note first, then the left bang starts the pluck, so every pluck has its new pitch.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import bangbang, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
both = patch.place(bangbang)[0]
pick = patch.place(random(12))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
pluck = patch.place("message 1 5 0 280")[0]
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], both.ins[0]),
    (both.outs[1], pick.ins[0]),       # right: first
    (pick.outs[0], note.ins[0]), (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (both.outs[0], pluck.ins[0]),      # left: second
    (pluck.outs[0], env.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]), (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("bangbang")
```

**b: flip a coin, then play.** b is short for bangbang. Its right bang asks decide for a 0 or 1, which closes or opens the gate; then its left bang sends a random note at the gate. About half the beats, the note doesn't change.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, decide, ezdac_tilde, gate, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(200, active=1))[0]
both = patch.place("b")[0]
coin = patch.place(decide)[0]
door = patch.place(gate(1, 1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(12))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], both.ins[0]), (both.outs[1], coin.ins[0]),
    (coin.outs[0], door.ins[0]),       # 0 shuts the gate, 1 opens it
    (both.outs[0], pick.ins[0]), (pick.outs[0], door.ins[1]), (door.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]), (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("b")
```

### `loadbang` (`loadbang`)

Send a bang when a patcher is loaded

**Set things up when the patch opens.** loadbang sends one bang when the patch starts. Here it sends 392 to cycle~, so the tone starts at G instead of 0 Hz.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, loadbang

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadbang)[0]
freq = patch.place("message 392")[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], freq.ins[0]),
    (freq.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("loadbang")
```

### `loadmess` (`loadmess`)

Send a message when a patch is loaded

**Start-up values.** loadmess sends its message once, when the patch starts. One sends 220 to cycle~ for the pitch; the other sends "1 3000" to line~, so the tone fades in over 3 seconds.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, loadmess

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
pitch = patch.place(loadmess(220))[0]
fade = patch.place("loadmess 1 3000")[0]   # to 1, over 3000 ms
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (pitch.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (fade.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("loadmess")
```

### `int` (`int_`)

Store an integer value

**Remember a number.** int holds a number: the right inlet stores one quietly, a bang in the left sends it out. Each beat it sends its number, and + 1 and % 8 store the next one back: a counter, climbing a whole-tone scale.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, int_, metro, mtof

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
hold = patch.place(int_)[0]
next_up = patch.place("+ 1")[0]
wrap = patch.place("% 8")[0]
step = patch.place("* 2")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], hold.ins[0]), (hold.outs[0], next_up.ins[0]), (next_up.outs[0], wrap.ins[0]),
    (wrap.outs[0], hold.ins[1]),       # cold: stored for the next beat, no loop
    (hold.outs[0], step.ins[0]), (step.outs[0], note.ins[0]), (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]), (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]), (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("int")
```

### `float` (`float_`)

Store a decimal number

**Hold a moving value.** line glides from 200 to 800 Hz over 4 seconds, into float's right inlet, which only stores it. A 250 ms metro bangs float to send what it holds, so the smooth glide comes out as a staircase of steps.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, float_, line, metro

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
again = patch.place(metro(4000, active=1))[0]
glide = patch.place("message 200, 800 4000")[0]
ramp = patch.place(line(0.))[0]       # a float argument: float output
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
hold = patch.place(float_)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (again.outs[0], glide.ins[0]),
    (glide.outs[0], ramp.ins[0]),
    (ramp.outs[0], hold.ins[1]),       # cold: store only
    (clock.outs[0], hold.ins[0]),      # hot: bang sends it
    (hold.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("float")
```

## Lists

Build, split and transform lists of values.

### `pack` (`pack`)

Create a list

**Glide from note to note.** pack 0 200 combines the note at its left inlet with the glide time at its right into one list, "note 200", which line slides through in 200 ms. Press ▶, then change the number box to set a new glide time.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line, metro, mtof, number, pack, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(400, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(13))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
glide = patch.place(number)[0]           # milliseconds (cold: waits for a note)
both = patch.place(pack(0, 200))[0]
slide = patch.place(line(60))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], both.ins[0]),
    (glide.outs[0], both.ins[1]),
    (both.outs[0], slide.ins[0]),
    (slide.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("pack")
```

### `pak` (`pak`)

Output a list when any element changes

**Every inlet plays.** pak is pack with every inlet hot: a number at any inlet sends the whole list. A slow clock moves the root at the left and a fast one walks a chord at the right; zl.sum adds them, and each change from either side plays.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, pak, zl_sum

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
slow = patch.place(metro(1000, active=1))[0]
roots = patch.place(counter(0, 2))[0]
root = patch.place("* 5")[0]             # 0 5 10: C, F, Bb
fast = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
steps = patch.place(counter(0, 3))[0]
chord = patch.place("* 4")[0]            # 0 4 8 12
both = patch.place(pak(0, 0))[0]
total = patch.place(zl_sum)[0]
note = patch.place("+ 55")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (slow.outs[0], roots.ins[0]),
    (roots.outs[0], root.ins[0]),
    (root.outs[0], both.ins[0]),
    (fast.outs[0], steps.ins[0]),
    (steps.outs[0], chord.ins[0]),
    (chord.outs[0], both.ins[1]),      # with pack, this inlet would only store
    (both.outs[0], total.ins[0]),
    (total.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("pak")
```

### `unpack` (`unpack`)

Break a list into individual messages

**One list, three notes.** unpack 0 0 0 sends each item of a list out of its own outlet. The list "60 64 67" becomes three numbers, one for each of three oscillators, which sound together as a C major chord.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, loadbang, mtof, unpack

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadbang)[0]
chord = patch.place("message 60 64 67")[0]
split = patch.place(unpack(0, 0, 0))[0]
hz_a, hz_b, hz_c = patch.place(mtof, num_objs=3)
osc_a, osc_b, osc_c = patch.place(cycle_tilde, num_objs=3)
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], chord.ins[0]),
    (chord.outs[0], split.ins[0]),
    (split.outs[0], hz_a.ins[0]),
    (split.outs[1], hz_b.ins[0]),
    (split.outs[2], hz_c.ins[0]),
    (hz_a.outs[0], osc_a.ins[0]),
    (hz_b.outs[0], osc_b.ins[0]),
    (hz_c.outs[0], osc_c.ins[0]),
    (osc_a.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (osc_b.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (osc_c.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("unpack")
```

### `iter` (`iter_`)

Break a list into individual messages

**A chord as an arpeggio.** iter sends the items of a list out one at a time. pipe holds each note longer the higher it is, 40 ms per semitone above 60, so the chord plays as a rising arpeggio. Press ▶, then change the number box to spread the notes out.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, iter_, metro, mtof, number, pipe, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(1000, active=1))[0]
chord = patch.place("message 60 64 67 72")[0]
each = patch.place(iter_)[0]
order = patch.place(trigger("i", "i"))[0]   # set the delay, then send the note
above = patch.place("- 60")[0]
spacing = patch.place("* 40")[0]
gap = patch.place(number)[0]             # milliseconds per semitone
later = patch.place(pipe(0))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], chord.ins[0]),
    (chord.outs[0], each.ins[0]),
    (each.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], above.ins[0]),
    (above.outs[0], spacing.ins[0]),
    (gap.outs[0], spacing.ins[1]),
    (spacing.outs[0], later.ins[1]),   # delay: 0, 160, 280, 480 ms
    (order.outs[0], later.ins[0]),
    (later.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("iter")
```

### `join` (`join`)

Combine items into a list

**An envelope in two halves.** join combines the lists at its inlets into one list. "1 5" (rise in 5 ms) and "0 300" (fall in 300 ms) join into the envelope "1 5 0 300" for line~, which strikes the tone on every beat.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, join, line_tilde, metro, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(400, active=1))[0]
order = patch.place(trigger("b", "b"))[0]
rise = patch.place("message 1 5")[0]
fall = patch.place("message 0 300")[0]
glue = patch.place(join(2))[0]
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(330))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], fall.ins[0]),      # right inlet first: stored
    (fall.outs[0], glue.ins[1]),
    (order.outs[0], rise.ins[0]),      # left inlet sends the joined list
    (rise.outs[0], glue.ins[0]),
    (glue.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("join")
```

### `prepend` (`prepend`)

Add a message in front of input

**Build an envelope from a number.** prepend puts its arguments in front of every message. The counter's 60 to 420 becomes "1 5 0 60" ... "1 5 0 420" for line~, so each strike rings a little longer than the last.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro, prepend

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(450, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(1, 7))[0]
ms = patch.place("* 60")[0]
envelope = patch.place(prepend("1 5 0"))[0]   # 300 -> "1 5 0 300"
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde(440))[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], ms.ins[0]),
    (ms.outs[0], envelope.ins[0]),
    (envelope.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("prepend")
```

### `append` (`append`)

Append arguments to the end of a message

**Add a glide time to each note.** append puts its arguments after every message. Each note becomes "note 150", which tells line to slide to it in 150 ms instead of jumping.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import append, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line, metro, mtof, random

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(13))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
timed = patch.place(append(150))[0]      # 64 -> "64 150"
slide = patch.place(line(60))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (pick.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], timed.ins[0]),
    (timed.outs[0], slide.ins[0]),
    (slide.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("append")
```

### `funnel` (`funnel`)

Tag data with its inlet number

**Which clock was that?.** funnel sends everything out of one outlet, with the number of the inlet it came in on in front. Two clocks share one oscillator: the inlet number picks C for the left clock and G for the right.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, funnel, metro, mtof, unpack

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
left = patch.place(metro(500, active=1))[0]
right = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
merge = patch.place(funnel(2))[0]        # a bang in inlet 1 -> "1 0"
split = patch.place(unpack(0, 0))[0]
fifth = patch.place("* 7")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (left.outs[0], merge.ins[0]),
    (right.outs[0], merge.ins[1]),
    (merge.outs[0], split.ins[0]),
    (split.outs[0], fifth.ins[0]),     # the inlet number: 0 or 1
    (fifth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("funnel")
```

### `listfunnel` (`listfunnel`)

Index and output list elements

**Load a melody into a table.** listfunnel turns a list into numbered pairs: "0 60", "1 63", "2 67" .... Each pair stores a note at that position in table, which the counter then reads back in order.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, listfunnel, loadbang, metro, mtof, table

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadbang)[0]
tune = patch.place("message 60 63 67 70 72 70 67 63")[0]
pairs = patch.place(listfunnel)[0]
notes = patch.place(table)[0]
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 7))[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], tune.ins[0]),
    (tune.outs[0], pairs.ins[0]),
    (pairs.outs[0], notes.ins[0]),     # "position note" stores
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], notes.ins[0]),      # a position alone reads
    (notes.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("listfunnel")
```

### `spray` (`spray`)

Distribute a value to a numbered outlet

**Send each note to a voice.** spray sends a value out of the outlet numbered in front of it: "0 64" goes out of the left outlet, "1 69" out of the right. Notes go to the two voices in turn, so each holds its note while the other moves.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, pack, random, spray, trigger

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
order = patch.place(trigger("b", "b"))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(13))[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
voice = patch.place(counter(0, 1))[0]    # 0 1 0 1 ...
pair = patch.place(pack(0, 0))[0]        # "voice note"
route = patch.place(spray(2))[0]
hz_a, hz_b = patch.place(mtof, num_objs=2)
osc_a, osc_b = patch.place(cycle_tilde, num_objs=2)
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], pick.ins[0]),      # the note first, into pack's cold inlet
    (pick.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], pair.ins[1]),
    (order.outs[0], voice.ins[0]),     # then the voice, which sends the pair
    (voice.outs[0], pair.ins[0]),
    (pair.outs[0], route.ins[0]),
    (route.outs[0], hz_a.ins[0]),
    (route.outs[1], hz_b.ins[0]),
    (hz_a.outs[0], osc_a.ins[0]),
    (hz_b.outs[0], osc_b.ins[0]),
    (osc_a.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (osc_b.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("spray")
```

### `zl.change` (`zl_change`)

Filter out list repetitions

**Strike only new notes.** zl.change lets a message through only when it differs from the one before. random picks one of 3 notes, often the same again; repeats are dropped, so they never strike a new note. Press ▶, then set the number box to 6: with more notes to pick from, repeats are rarer and more beats strike.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, line_tilde, metro, mtof, number, random, trigger, zl_change

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
pick = patch.place(random(3))[0]
choices = patch.place(number)[0]         # how many notes random picks from
new = patch.place(zl_change)[0]
order = patch.place(trigger("b", "i"))[0]   # set the pitch, then strike
spread = patch.place("* 5")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
strike = patch.place("message 1 5 0 300")[0]   # up in 5 ms, down in 300
env = patch.place(line_tilde)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
amp = patch.place("*~ 0.")[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], pick.ins[0]),
    (choices.outs[0], pick.ins[1]),
    (pick.outs[0], new.ins[0]),
    (new.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], spread.ins[0]),
    (spread.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[0], strike.ins[0]),
    (strike.outs[0], env.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], amp.ins[0]),
    (env.outs[0], amp.ins[1]),
    (amp.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("zl.change")
```

### `zl.compare` (`zl_compare`)

Compare two lists

**Hear when two lists match.** zl.compare sends 1 when the list at its left inlet equals the one at its right, and 0 when not. The counter's numbers go by in pairs, and each time a pair is "0 1" the note jumps up a fifth.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, loadbang, metro, mtof, zl_compare, zl_group

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
start = patch.place(loadbang)[0]
target = patch.place("message 0 1")[0]
clock = patch.place(metro(150, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(0, 2))[0]     # 0 1 2 0 1 2 ...
pair = patch.place(zl_group(2))[0]       # (0 1) (2 0) (1 2) (0 1) ...
same = patch.place(zl_compare)[0]
fifth = patch.place("* 7")[0]
note = patch.place("+ 60")[0]
hz = patch.place(mtof)[0]
osc = patch.place(cycle_tilde)[0]
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (start.outs[0], target.ins[0]),
    (target.outs[0], same.ins[1]),     # the list to look for
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], pair.ins[0]),
    (pair.outs[0], same.ins[0]),
    (same.outs[0], fifth.ins[0]),
    (fifth.outs[0], note.ins[0]),
    (note.outs[0], hz.ins[0]),
    (hz.outs[0], osc.ins[0]),
    (osc.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("zl.compare")
```

### `zl.delace` (`zl_delace`)

De-interleave a list

**Unzip a list into tune and bass.** zl.delace sends the 1st, 3rd, 5th ... items out of its left outlet and the 2nd, 4th, 6th ... out of its right. The list alternates tune and bass notes, so it plays as two voices.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, trigger, zl_delace, zl_nth

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(300, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(1, 4))[0]
order = patch.place(trigger("b", "i"))[0]
pairs = patch.place("message 67 48 69 53 71 55 72 48")[0]   # tune, bass, tune, bass ...
unzip = patch.place(zl_delace)[0]
tune = patch.place(zl_nth(1))[0]
bass = patch.place(zl_nth(1))[0]
hz_tune, hz_bass = patch.place(mtof, num_objs=2)
osc_tune, osc_bass = patch.place(cycle_tilde, num_objs=2)
quiet = patch.place("*~ 0.2")[0]
out = patch.place(ezdac_tilde)[0]

patch.connect(
    (clock.outs[0], step.ins[0]),
    (step.outs[0], order.ins[0]),
    (order.outs[1], tune.ins[1]),
    (order.outs[1], bass.ins[1]),
    (order.outs[0], pairs.ins[0]),
    (pairs.outs[0], unzip.ins[0]),
    (unzip.outs[0], tune.ins[0]),      # 67 69 71 72
    (unzip.outs[1], bass.ins[0]),      # 48 53 55 48
    (tune.outs[0], hz_tune.ins[0]),
    (bass.outs[0], hz_bass.ins[0]),
    (hz_tune.outs[0], osc_tune.ins[0]),
    (hz_bass.outs[0], osc_bass.ins[0]),
    (osc_tune.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (osc_bass.outs[0], quiet.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[0]),
    (quiet.outs[0], out.ins[1]),
)
patch.save("zl.delace")
```

### `zl.filter` (`zl_filter`)

Remove items in a list

**Leave out the black keys.** zl.filter removes from a list every item that is also in the list at its right inlet. Taking 61 63 66 68 70 out of all 13 notes from 60 to 72 leaves the C major scale.

```python
import maxpylang as mp
from maxpylang.objects import counter, cycle_tilde, ezdac_tilde, metro, mtof, trigger, zl_filter, zl_nth

patch = mp.MaxPatch()
clock = patch.place(metro(250, active=1))[0]
step = patch.place(counter(1, 8))[0]
order = patch.place(trigger("b", "b", "i"))[0]
every = patch.place("message 60 61 62 63 64 65 66 67 68 69 70 71 72")[0]
black = patch.place("message 61 63 66 68 70")[0]
```
